answer: An agent economy can require each voting identity to lock 100 tokens in a vault for 30 days before its votes count, with one vote per bonded identity. Agents named falcon and echo follow the same rule as everyone else. Creating 1,000 fake voters therefore requires locking 100,000 tokens for the full period. Sybils remain possible, but multiplying identities ties up capital, imposing financing and opportunity costs on the attacker.
